cause: All five formerly shared identical CrownArchitecture settings, one leader, golden-angle primaries, identical three-fork secondary intervals and foliage intervals; prop roots used radial foot placement and almost linear midpoint curves.
controls: Opt-in branching profiles: leader count, leader split height/spread, secondary fork start, explicit primary levels and cacao pod count. Existing crown parameters tuned per species.
limitations: Root and branch junctions share a batch but are not watertight boolean unions; ring transitions remain visible close up.
Pneumatophore field is synthetic, not a tidal habitat simulation.
Cacao pods are simple tapered colored meshes with attachment stalks, not fully ribbed fruits.
Stylosa upright versus mangle low spreading is an art-directed V1 choice, not a universal species distinction.
Materials, atlases, lighting, ecological records and unrelated species are unchanged.
